novelty_basis: Same searches as CLM-C16-05; the counts 0, 0, 0, 3360 were not found. Small.
proof_check: computer-assisted - exhaustive analysis of all Latin squares of orders 2-5, confirmed by an independent depth-first enumeration (0, 0, 0, 3360); explicit certificates for orders 6-16 re-verified by an independent cycle analysis; products by Theorem 6 (EXP-C16-02)
statement:
There is no full-period quasigroup of order 2, 3 or 4; there are exactly 3360 of order 5, forming 28 isomorphism
classes; full-period quasigroups of every order 6, ..., 16 and of orders 30, 35, 40, 42, 45, 56, 63, 72 exist.
title: Full-period quasigroups: none of order 2, 3, 4; 3360 of order 5; examples of every order 6-16
